annotation.title_clean: Republic of Ghana National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2035
annotation.title_en: Republic of Ghana National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2035
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations (Ghana)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations, Ghana
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Ghana's 2025-2035 national AI strategy sets eight pillars covering education, youth jobs, infrastructure, data governance, ecosystem, sectoral adoption, research and public-sector adoption. It proposes a Responsible AI Authority, a National AI Fund, and alignment with the UNESCO AI Ethics Recommendation, favouring soft-guideline regulation. It has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establish an independent Responsible AI Authority within the first year to coordinate implementation
Create a National AI Fund of 5 billion cedis scaling to 15 billion
Align with UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI and the Readiness Assessment Methodology
Soft guideline-based regulatory approach; consider mandatory insurance for high-risk AI outputs and AI audit/certification tools
Transform Data Protection Commission into an Authority; data classification and sovereignty framework
